changelog:
1.0.14

  • Applied updates, Imported content and Prices still typed out show 10 at a time, with Show 10, 30 or All and Previous/Next page buttons.
  • A tick box at the top of the typed-prices list ticks every row on that page.
  • The typed-prices list keeps the space before each price.

1.0.13

  • Prices: one list of your prices on the Tech Importer screen. Type a price tag like [tech_price key="basic"] in Elementor instead of the number, and when you change the price in the list every page using that tag updates. Saving clears the Elementor and WP Rocket caches.
  • A zip can add prices to the list (only new ones, so prices you changed are kept).
  • The Prices box shows which pages use each tag, and lists prices that are still typed out as plain text so you can turn the ones you pick into tags, with the usual preview, Apply and Undo.

1.0.12

  • Page updates can add a block inside a section, right above a named heading (used to move the DIY / Do it for me cards to the middle of guides).
  • Old blocks can be removed even after the editor reformatted them. Updates that were already applied show as skipped.

1.0.11

  • The Tech Importer screen checks GitHub fresh every time it opens, so the Update button shows as soon as a new version is out.

1.0.10

  • Text updates still work on pages that were edited by hand: if the exact text was reformatted by the editor, the update finds its anchor words and adds the new part right after that block. Updates that are already on a page are skipped.

1.0.9

  • Sticky phone bar: Call and Free consultation buttons pinned to the bottom of the screen on phones, with settings on the Tech Importer screen.
  • Page updates can now add a whole new section after a named section or heading, with the same preview, checks and Undo.

1.0.8

  • The version banner only shows when an update is available (or a check failed). Its Update button installs the new version right from the Tech Importer screen.

1.0.7

  • Update status box on the Tech Importer screen: installed version, latest on GitHub, last check error, and a Check GitHub now button. A failed check retries after 15 minutes instead of 6 hours.

1.0.6

  • Imported content table shows the published date and time for each item.

1.0.5

  • Updates to existing pages: zips can now carry link and text changes for live pages. Each one is previewed first, applied only when you click Apply, checked after saving (page loads, headings, images and forms still there), and put back automatically if the check fails. Undo button for every applied update.

1.0.4

  • Publish and Preview buttons in Imported content. Publishing clears the WP Rocket cache.
  • Imports save a plain text copy of the page, so Yoast in the WordPress editor can read the words, links and images.

1.0.3

  • Automatic updates from GitHub.

1.0.2

  • Remove button and Imported content table.

1.0.0

  • First release: zip import of drafts with Elementor, Yoast and images.
